newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds lower, no sparks from new finmin.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds lower, no sparks from new finmin.

text.p: 1640 GMT - Austrian bonds inched down on Thursday, following a weak German market, designation of Vienna City finance councillor Rudolf Edlinger as new finance minister fails to inspire markets.
Traders note demand at the short-end, slight pressure at the longer end.
* 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 down 20 bps at 100.65 to yield 5.78 (5.75) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.46/56 to yield 5.80/79.
* At the near end, five-year 5.50 percent bond maturing March 2001 down 15 bps at 103.90 to yield 4.46 (4.50) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 103.86/96 to yield 4.51/48 percent.
* AGB future down 27 bps at 108.22 on turnover of 1,624 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany down steady at two bps, five-year spread down one at four bps.
* Money market rates lower with three-month VIBOR at 3.317 and overnight money at 2.89/3.14.
